g.title: Sheet.210
g.desc: R1 relies on the Type 3 LSAs created by the ABRs, which have ...
g.text: R1 relies on the Type 3 LSAs created by the ABRs, which have the following information:o The subnet number and mask.o The ABR’s lowest cost to reach Subnet-X.o The RID of the ABR.

g.title: Sheet.218
g.desc: R1 doesn’t have topological data (LSA Types 1 and 2) for othe...
g.text: R1 doesn’t have topological data (LSA Types 1 and 2) for other areas.R1 does NOT know the topology inside Area 0.
